technical.summary: Hull MA flip and MACD/PPO crossovers show early momentum, but price remains below key moving averages with weak trend strength (ADX 24.4) and negative money flow, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CPT shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 44 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (304), strong dollar pressures multinationals, CPI event imminent, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull MA flip + MACD/PPO crossovers signal early momentum reversal in extreme fear environment (21/100), offering contrarian entry near support at 116.594.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), price trapped below all key moving averages with weak ADX (24.4), negative money flow, zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 44 days make this a low-conviction setup in unfavourable conditions.
